name: Freezing Runes
disable: DC 36 Arcana check (expert) to deactivate the runes, DC 38 Thievery check (master) to scratch out the runes, or Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 34)
reset: Unless disabled or destroyed, the hazard resets automatically after being triggered.

items.name: Freezing Whirl
items.text:
Trigger A living creature attempts to leave area F3 while carrying anything edible, even a consumable such as an elixir or potion

---
Effect An icy draft rises from the runes and whirls about the triggering creature. The creature takes 6d12+35 cold damage, with a DC 37 basic Fortitude save save. On a failure, the creature is also Slowed 1 for 1 minute. On critical failure, the creature is instead Petrified as they become encased in a layer of ice. A creature petrified in this way can be restored if exposed to a significant heat source (such as a campfire) for 10 minutes.

text: Spirals of cold energy rise from the runes to strike those sneaking food out of the area.
